clauses.reason: whole: Executive Order No. 9528 of March 2, 1945, providing for a change in the order of succession of officers to act as Secretary of the Navy, "is hereby revoked". The order states no effective date, so the revocation was performed on signing, August 13, 1945; the filing date, August 14, 1945, and the Federal Register issue date, August 15, 1945, are not used. The command is exhausted by performance and EO 9528 stays revoked.

The held page text goes on to print Department of Agriculture regulations; they are other documents and were not used. The order states no effective date, so the one-time revocation was performed on signing, 1945-08-13; EO 9528 stays revoked as a surviving consequence.
